S035-01.notes: Folding tables, bedsheets, car batteries = improvised clinic. 'Permanent', 'specialized', 'luxurious' contradict the details.

S035-02.notes: Contemporaries dismissed it; later measurements vindicate it -> prescient. Arrhenius 1896 doubling-CO2 estimate (~5-6 C) consistent with 'several degrees'. Arbitrary/outdated/deliberate don't fit the vindication logic.

S035-03.notes: Text describes brainless mold reproducing Tokyo-area rail network (Tero et al. 2010, oat flakes at city positions, spread then pruned), then engineers' interest. No theory rejected, no second organism, no rail-system problem. Facts accurate.

S035-04.notes: Timber scarcity + 'walked' tradition + 2012 upright replica rocked with ropes (Lipo/Hunt; 18 people, ~100 m in under an hour) -> moved upright with ropes. 'May have' appropriately hedged. A contradicts quarry; C contradicts tradition consistency; D overreaches and conflicts with experiment. Facts accurate.

flags: minor: A establishes the 'nearly as much' comparison (0.1 s gap) but does not cite the no-call baseline that shows both kinds of calls slow reactions; D is a fairly tempting distractor since it shows both call conditions elevated vs. baseline. The ideal support would compare the 0.4 s vs 0.5 s slowdowns; consider rewording A to include the baseline or the increases.
S035-05.notes: Conclusion's core claim is that hands-free slowdown is close to handheld slowdown; A directly gives the near-equality. B and C each address only one call condition; D shows both are slower but 'more than 1.2' does not establish closeness.

S035-06.notes: Only C isolates ground vibrations (no airborne sound) and shows a response. A is airborne; B and D are about call production. Consistent with O'Connell-Rodwell's Etosha seismic playback work.

S035-07.notes: Goal is purpose; only B states purpose (prevent jamming of torpedo guidance signals). 1942 patent with Antheil, 88 frequencies accurate.

S035-08.notes: Contrast/qualification: most from asteroids, but a few from Mars. Accordingly (cause), For example (illustration of asteroid origin - wrong), Similarly (likeness) fail. Viking 1976 atmospheric match (SNC/EETA79001 gases) accurate.

S035-09.notes: List items contain internal commas, so items must be separated by semicolons; preceding separator after 'Chile' is a semicolon, so 'Peru; and Guayaquil' keeps consistency. A mixes separators; C omits separator; D colon wrong.

S035-10.notes: 'required that every vessel ___' takes the mandative subjunctive base form 'store'. 'stores' and 'stored' are tempting but nonstandard here; 'storing' makes a fragment clause.
